response.original_title: Fastest Known Time: The Arc of Attrition
response.overview: A raw, unfiltered look at endurance athlete Mike Samuels' attempt to do something no one has ever done before: Set the world’s first FKT for the brutal Arc of Attrition Double. This isn’t just another ultra. It’s over 200 miles of relentless Cornish coastline, jagged cliffs, and endless climbs.
